items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: It said, "Wilhelmina Breaux Presents the Original Boozaire(?) Kings."

ctx.x: would be a crowd around us like this. Man, we celebrated. So she gave a dance at the Franz(?) Ami, which is the big Creole hall where all the muckamucks go, real staunch-down Creoles, Free Men of Color, all that shit. It said, "Wilhelmina Breaux Presents the Original Boozaire(?) Kings." And she gave this thing. And man, that fuckin' place was packed and jammed. And I didn't set no price for it. I should have known it; I'd been doing this long enough. When she got through, she gave us a dollar-and-a-half a piece.…

But then we went to the Lyric Theatre. And the first time we worked there, we stopped the show. They had an amateur hour, and they used to have all the same little kids come every week. You've seen that.
